title: Kota Kinabalu Half Marathon 2026 Review: JomRun Sabah Capital-City 21K with Ultron Gear and Borneo Series
seo_title: Kota Kinabalu Half Marathon 2026 Review | Sabah Malaysia Borneo Race
meta_description: Comprehensive Kota Kinabalu Half Marathon 2026 review: JomRun Borneo Series 21.1K at Likas Stadium, Ultron finisher jersey, Sabah monsoon climate, Mount Kinabalu views, and everything you need to know before 16 August.
dek: Set for 16 August 2026 finishing at Likas Stadium in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, this JomRun-powered 21.1K is part of the JomRun Half Marathon Series Borneo, with Ultron race apparel, a TrackAsia timing chip, and an exclusive series medal for runners who complete all four Borneo legs.
verdict: The Kota Kinabalu Half Marathon is a 21.1K road race in Sabah capital. Organised by JomRun for 16 August 2026 at Likas Stadium. Three distances (21.1K, 10K, 5K). Ultron brand race jerseys, TrackAsia RFID timing, Borneo Series medal for completing all four East Malaysia legs. KK also hosts separate February and May events via other organisers. Registration open via JomRun.

paragraphs: Kota Kinabalu, KK to locals, is Sabah capital and Borneo gateway, a city wedged between the South China Sea and Crocker Range, with Mount Kinabalu (4,095 m) visible on clear mornings from the waterfront. Likas Stadium is Sabah premier sports complex with track, grandstand, and extensive event infrastructure. The JomRun Half Marathon Series Borneo ties KK with Kuching, Bintulu, and Miri for an exclusive series medal.
sections.heading: Kota Kinabalu: Sabah Coastal Capital

paragraphs: JomRun is Malaysia dominant race-registration platform. KK entitlements include an Ultron event jersey, finisher medal, e-certificate, and a separate Ultron finisher jersey for 21.1K completers. TrackAsia RFID timing chip in the bib ensures professional results. The Borneo Series structure creates an incentive to commit to the full four-race circuit across Sabah and Sarawak.
sections.heading: JomRun Experience: Entitlements and Timing

paragraphs: The course starts at Karamunsing, a central KK commercial district, and finishes at Likas Stadium. Route mixes city-centre roads and coastal highway sections with South China Sea views. KK terrain is modestly rolling along the coastal plain. August is the southwest monsoon with warm, humid conditions and a moderate chance of morning rain.
sections.heading: The Course: Karamunsing to Likas Stadium

paragraphs: A critical warning: Kota Kinabalu hosts at least three separate events using the words half marathon in their names. The JomRun edition (August, Likas Stadium, Ultron apparel, Borneo Series) is distinct from the Borneo Half Marathon (February, Kinabalu Running Club) and Borneo International Marathon (May). Confirm the date, organiser, and venue before registering.
sections.heading: Avoiding KK Race Confusion

paragraphs: Registration is open through the JomRun platform. The 2025 edition featured a three-day bib-collection window at Likas Sports Complex, and a similar multi-day pickup is expected for 2026. Kota Kinabalu International Airport (BKI) serves Sabah with direct flights from KL, Singapore, and regional centres. Likas Stadium is roughly 15 minutes by Grab from the airport.
sections.heading: Registration and Logistics

paragraphs: If you are a runner based in Sabah or travelling to Borneo and want a half marathon with JomRun reliable registration, a Likas Stadium finish, an Ultron finisher jersey, and the Borneo Series narrative to work toward, the Kota Kinabalu Half Marathon is a solid, bookable pick for 16 August 2026. Register through JomRun while the window is open, and if you are committed to the full Borneo Series, use KK as your anchor race.

faqs.question: When is the KK Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The JomRun Kota Kinabalu City Half Marathon is scheduled for 16 August 2026, starting from Karamunsing and finishing at Likas Stadium in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah. It offers three distances: 21.1K, 10K, and 5K. Registration is currently open through the JomRun platform. The race is part of the JomRun Half Marathon Series Borneo alongside Kuching, Bintulu, and Miri.

faqs.question: What do I get with registration?
faqs.answer: All registered runners receive an Ultron event jersey, finisher medal, and e-certificate. 21.1K finishers also receive a separate Ultron finisher jersey. The 21.1K bib carries a TrackAsia RFID timing chip. Runners who complete all four Borneo Series legs earn an exclusive series medal.

faqs.question: How do I avoid confusing this with other KK races?
faqs.answer: KK hosts multiple half marathons. The JomRun edition (August, Likas Stadium finish, Ultron apparel, Borneo Series) is distinct from the Borneo Half Marathon (February) and Borneo International Marathon (May). Confirm date (August), organiser (JomRun), and venue (Likas Stadium).

faqs.question: What is the course and weather like?
faqs.answer: The course runs from Karamunsing through central KK to Likas Stadium, mixing city roads with coastal highway sections. Elevation is modest on the coastal plain. August is the southwest monsoon: warm and humid with a moderate chance of morning rain. Coastal breezes off the South China Sea provide cooling on Likas Bay sections.

faqs.question: How does bib collection work?
faqs.answer: The 2025 edition had a three-day bib-collection window at Likas Sports Complex, and a similar multi-day pickup is expected for 2026. The Likas Sports Complex provides parking, shelter, and permanent facilities. Runners arriving Friday can collect kits ahead of the Saturday race.
